items.reason: Describes the same unchecked null fallback from getResourceTypeResource before findByResource in ClientPermissionsV2.hasPermission.

Describes cleanup executing against V2 and throwing UnsupportedOperationException when both flags are enabled. Issue #01 concerns cleanup being skipped and leaving orphaned permissions; fixing this crash would not fix that omission.
Identifies the same missing global MANAGE check in canView(). Although it describes a different consequence, correcting that omission addresses issue #09.
Claims an existing per-client resource incorrectly prevents fallback to a global grant. This differs from #04's null fallback and #10's global VIEW shortcut bypassing client-specific denials.

Claims excessive scanning and policy-evaluation cost in getClientsWithPermission. Issue #03 concerns selecting the wrong resources and returning names instead of client IDs; optimizing the scan would not fix that problem.
